

# dwnl.exe is all Rust (dwnl-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dwnl-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# dwnl.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/dwnl-rust/src/dwnl/dwnl.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(dwnl_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_compile_definitions(dwnl_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(dwnl_res OBJECT dwnl.rc)
target_compile_definitions(dwnl_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(dwnl_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(DWNL_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils_rust.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/pseh/libpseh.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/uuid/libuuid.a)
if(ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    list(APPEND DWNL_REUSED ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/libchkstk.a)
endif()
if(ARCH STREQUAL "arm64")
    list(APPEND DWNL_REUSED ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/libchkstk.a)
endif()
add_cargo_module(dwnl dwnl-cargo dwnl.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE dwnl-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dwnl_shims dwnl_res ${DWNL_REUSED})
